text: {"rules":[{"id":"DRUG-USE-SCREEN-18PLUS","version":"June 2020","title":"Unhealthy drug use screening by asking questions, adults 18 years or older","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening by asking questions about unhealthy drug use in adults age 18 years or older.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2020-06","action":"Screen for unhealthy drug use by asking questions (not biological specimen testing)","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults age 18 years or older\"}","numerator":"{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"drug_use_screening\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"screening by asking questions about unhealthy drug use\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"the text states no screening interval; a measurement-year window is assumed for checking and needs human approval\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["No screening interval is stated in the text; the measurement-year window in DRUG-USE-SCREEN-18PLUS is an assumption, declared as derived, and needs human review.","Implementation condition not represented: 'Screening should be implemented when services for accurate diagnosis, effective treatment, and appropriate care can be offered or referred.'
